name: SSHI_FullBridge
rationale: The open-circuit voltage of the piezo (~0.76V) is lower than the required load voltage (1.8V). A standard SSHI (Synchronous Switch Harvesting on Inductor) topology is used to invert the voltage across the piezo capacitance at each peak, effectively boosting the voltage to a level that can overcome the diode drops of a full-bridge rectifier and charge the storage capacitor to 1.8V. A Zener diode is added to clamp the output at 3.3V to prevent exceeding the absolute maximum of 3.6V.
